integrity: The lattice identities are proved uniformly in n and replayed by an embedded finite checker for n=2 through 8. published-findings semantic index, the current/prior slot ledger, the Liu--Zhu full text, and public searches for the later Wu generalization were checked before acceptance.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for affine maximal-cone toric charts at torus fixed points; it does not determine every orbit-stratum local class group or completed local analytic type.
The later Wu preprint was compared through primary metadata and detailed indexed summaries because full-text retrieval through the available primary-source path failed during this run.
title: Local divisor class groups at the torus fixed points of the Liu--Zhu small-alpha examples
